validity_domain.condition: The paper assumes mixing only with the electron neutrino for simplicity.
The analysis takes the scalar mediator mass larger than the sterile mass, often m_phi about 10 m_s, so sterile masses can be neglected during production.
The model study scans mediator masses from a few keV to a few GeV.
Production regimes are derived from the full Boltzmann equation for oscillation-driven sterile production with sterile self-interactions.

global.description: Only active-sterile mixing with the electron neutrino is included; more complex flavor mixing is stated to be straightforward and minor for the considered phenomenology.
Sterile neutrinos couple to a real Standard Model singlet scalar through a Yukawa interaction.
When mapping parameter space, the Yukawa coupling is chosen so sterile neutrinos make up the full dark-matter abundance.
